scene.prompt: Delhi on the Yamuna plain: red sandstone minarets, domed tombs, mud-brick lanes, dusty fields and mango groves
Hampi on the Tungabhadra river: granite boulder hills, towering temple gopurams, stone bazaar colonnades, banana groves and paddy fields
Gaur and Pandua in the Bengal delta: brick mosques with curved roofs, bamboo huts on stilts, rice paddies, river boats and palm trees
Cambay and Ahmedabad in Gujarat: carved stone stepwells, white Jain temples, mosques with lattice windows, a busy harbour with dhows and cotton fields
